seed: A layer's track lists only what is animated (video-animate.html, 'A track lists only what is animated'), at Next defaults with no switch touched. Add Key on the recording and on a title typed over it puts one hollow moment on the clip's key line and no rows. Animate > Scale from the clip's right click adds a Scale row. A click on the row's name picks it and Backspace stops it animating: the row leaves. Animate > Scale from a right click on the key line's diamond brings it back. Then, two seconds on, the title dragged across the canvas keys its Position by itself, holding where it was at the first key, and the Position row appears.

steps.comment: THE FIRST TEST, a recording: Add Key is one hollow moment and no rows.

steps.note: Add Key on the recording at one second: one hollow diamond on its key line and no rows under it

steps.comment: THE SECOND TEST, a title: Add Key is one hollow moment and no rows.

steps.note: Add Key on the title at one second: one hollow diamond on its key line, and no row for anything

steps.comment: THE THIRD TEST: Animate > Scale on the clip's right click adds one row.
THE FOURTH TEST: a click on the row's name picks it, and Backspace stops it animating.

steps.note: the Scale row's name clicked: the row is picked, tinted in the gutter

steps.comment: THE FIFTH TEST: Animate > Scale from a right click on the key line's diamond brings it back.
THE SIXTH TEST: two seconds on, drag the title across the canvas: Position keys itself.

steps.note: at three seconds the title dragged 140 to the right: Position joined by itself, with a key at one second holding where it was and one at three where the hand left it
